measurement_note: Size is P + L, where P is the product catalog size and L is the total number of line items across all bills. The tiers repeat full-catalog bills, so building a price hash map and processing line items takes O(P + L) time. A correct slower alternative linearly searches the P-entry catalog for every line item, taking O(PL) time. Product counts and bill counts remain within the respective 200-product and 1000-call limits, and the slower implementation completes every tier.
